title: Godot 4.6 GLTFDocument
fact: append_from_file reads glTF into GLTFState; generate_scene creates a Godot scene; generated custom functionality belongs to explicit GLTFDocumentExtension hooks.

title: Godot 4.6 GLTFState
fact: GLTFState exposes parsed JSON, node records, materials, animations, and get_scene_node(gltf_node_index)/get_node_index(scene_node) mappings.

title: Godot 4.6 model export considerations
fact: Godot uses right-handed Y-up coordinates; cameras face -Z and oriented model fronts +Z. Material parameters and rendered appearance require separate comparisons.

title: Godot 4.6 command-line tutorial
fact: headless selects headless display and Dummy audio. Command-line script/path options exist. Unknown arguments may be silently ignored, so selected options require actual observation.

title: Godot 4.6 ResourceImporterScene
fact: Editor scene importing has geometry compression, LOD, tangent, animation, root-scale and name-suffix options; its defaults are not a neutral identity mapping.

title: Godot 4.6 PackedScene
fact: Packing saves a node and the nodes it owns. Serialization ownership needs explicit checking and is not OntoKin physical ownership.

title: Godot 4.6 AnimationPlayer
fact: AnimationPlayer updates target properties at the process frame. A future observer must force/evaluate the intended sample rather than assuming a seek command already changed native transforms.

title: Official Godot 4.6.3 release announcement
fact: The announcement identifies source commit 35e80b3a8; current tag readback gives full 35e80b3a8822a9df9be390814b62f44c0a9c69e8. This differs from the installed binary adjacent commit-like string.

title: Godot glTF implementation at observed release-tag commit
